items.question: What do you offer?
items.answer: We offer perfumes and gift sets in men, women, and unisex variants which includes Perfume trial pack, full-size, and pocket perfume bottles. You can also build your own customized box of favorite fragrances.

items.question: What if I enter the wrong address?
items.answer: Contact our support team immediately to fix it before shipping.

items.question: How long does delivery take?
items.answer: Our orders usually take 3-7 business days to deliver the order at your doorstep.

items.question: How can I track my order?
items.answer: After placing an order, you’ll receive a tracking link by SMS/email. You can also use the “Track Order” option in the app to know the details of your order.

items.question: Are your perfumes long-lasting?
items.answer: Our perfumes are designed to last for about 10-12 hours, depending on your skin type, weather, and how you apply them.

items.question: Do you offer free shipping?
items.answer: Yes, we provide free shipping on all orders above ₹399.

items.question: Do you have bulk purchase offers?
items.answer: Yes, we offer special pricing for bulk purchase and corporate orders. Please contact our support team for more details.

items.question: How do I contact customer support?
items.answer: You can email us at support@blabliblulife.com or call/WhatsApp us at +91 9220508119 (Monday–Saturday, 10 AM to 7 PM).

items.question: What is your refund policy?
items.answer: We offer refunds for damaged or incorrect orders. Reach out within 7 days of delivery with your order number and our team will sort it out.

about-us.title: About Us
about-us.body:
Bla Bli Blu is an Indian fragrance house built on one stubborn idea: luxury smelling perfume should not cost a luxury. We blend in small batches, keep the perfume oil concentration at 25%, and build every scent from real customer feedback instead of boardroom guesses.

From our 100% redeemable trial packs to the build-your-own box, everything we make is designed so you can find your signature scent without gambling your money.

Against the Ordinary!

terms-of-service.title: Terms of Service
terms-of-service.body: By accessing or purchasing from Bla Bli Blu you agree to our terms of service. Products are for personal use; resale without written consent is not permitted. We reserve the right to cancel orders that appear fraudulent or to update pricing and availability at any time.

privacy-policy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy-policy.body: We collect only the data needed to fulfil your order: name, contact details, shipping address and order history. We never sell your data. Payment information is handled by our payment partners and is never stored on our servers.

shipping-policy.title: Shipping Policy
shipping-policy.body: Free shipping on all orders above ₹399. Orders are dispatched within 24-48 hours and delivered in 3-7 business days across India. Cash on delivery is available on all pincodes we serve.

refund-policy.title: Refund Policy
refund-policy.body: Damaged, defective or incorrectly shipped products are eligible for a refund or replacement when reported within 7 days of delivery with order number and unboxing proof. Refunds are processed to the original payment method within 5-7 business days.

exchange-policy.title: Exchange Policy
exchange-policy.body: Sealed, unopened products can be exchanged within 7 days of delivery. Trial packs and opened bottles cannot be exchanged for hygiene reasons.

cashback-terms-conditions.title: Cashback Terms & Conditions
cashback-terms-conditions.body: Cashback is credited as store credit and auto-applied at checkout. Trial pack value is 100% redeemable against any full-size bottle. Cashback cannot be clubbed with other coupons and expires 30 days after issue.

wholesale-contact-form.title: Bulk Orders - Query Form
wholesale-contact-form.body: Planning gifting for your team, college fest or wedding? Write to support@blabliblulife.com with quantity, timeline and pincode and our bulk orders team will share custom pricing within one business day.
